description: This file contains internal definitions and structures for cryptographic digest functions in OpenSSL, including function pointers for initialization, update, and finalization of digest computations, as well as context management.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Hashes data into the digest context.

methods.name: final
methods.description: Completes the hash and outputs the digest.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees the pkey context when the digest context is freed.

methods.name: dup
methods.description: Duplicates the pkey context when the digest context is copied.
